##### Project general facts

Mamsha Palm by Aldar is a rare collection of exclusive residences designed by the internationally acclaimed architect Koichi Takada. Biophilic design, inspired by the protective canopy of palm trees that cools its surroundings, runs through the building, providing dappled shade and shelter from the sun. The building rises above two basement levels and a ground floor to six residential floors, offering one-bedroom, two-bedroom with study and three-bedroom residences, together with four-bedroom duplex sky villas with a maid's room.

Amenities are inspired by Japanese traditions of calm and balance. Residents are welcomed into a double-height lobby with a dedicated concierge, and can gather in a traditional Japanese tea room or soak away the day in a traditional Japanese bathhouse with a sauna and ice bath. A fully equipped gym supports an active routine, a children's playroom offers a world of discovery for the youngest residents, and an elevated infinity pool overlooks the island and the sea.

Residences feature refined finishes and spacious layouts crafted to embrace views of cultural landmarks and the endless sea. Interiors combine porcelain and engineered wood floors, fluted wood kitchen cabinets and vanities, engineered stone countertops and bathtubs, back-painted glass and fabric laminated glass wardrobe doors and brushed black metal sanitary fittings. Sky villas add generous duplex living spaces and private outdoor areas. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Saadiyat Island is Abu Dhabi's cultural heart, combining world-class museums, pristine beaches and calm residential neighbourhoods. Mamsha Al Saadiyat sits within the Saadiyat Cultural District, steps from Louvre Abu Dhabi, Zayed National Museum and Guggenheim Abu Dhabi, with a beachfront promenade lined with cafes, restaurants and boutiques overlooking the sea and the soft white sand, creating a relaxed, cultured setting for everyday life.

Louvre Abu Dhabi is within walking distance, and the island's beaches, fine dining venues and shopping destinations are close at hand. Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Highway connects residents with the Abu Dhabi Corniche, the city centre, Yas Island and Zayed International Airport, all within an easy drive, while premium schools, universities and healthcare facilities serve families across the island and in neighbouring districts.

Saadiyat Island is an investment zone open to international buyers and one of the most prestigious addresses in the UAE. Boutique residences by a renowned architect in the heart of the cultural district are in very limited supply, supporting strong demand from high-net-worth buyers and premium tenants. The island's cultural offer, beaches and connectivity underpin long-term value and resilient resale prospects.
